# SynergyOS v0.7
## ✨ Changes
```diff
+ 26H2 Experimental Support
+ SynToolkit Installation by Default
- Removed Defender Removal Checkbox as it was causing bugs with removal
```
## ⚠️ Notes
- Defaults unchanged for existing options: Remove Edge and Disable Xbox Services remain checked by default, SynToolkit will now install by default. 
- ISO Injection is still under Development, If you choose to utilize ISO Injection make sure to re-run the playbook when you install the modified ISO.
- 26H2 is experimental, Unexpected bugs may arise.
- If you removed defender in previous version then you'll need to reinstall windows to apply this version. 

# SynToolkit v1.7
**Highlights:** The biggest update yet. This release adds new Games Tab, Audio Mixer, Tweaks, and Uninstaller tabs, a heavily reworked Power Plans tab, GPU driver downloads, and a round of UI polish and fixes.

👉 **Changelogs:** https://github.com/Synergy-Tweaks/SynToolkit/releases
**Download:** `SynToolkit-Setup-1.7.0.exe` through the SynergyOS Setup when prompted in Ame Wizard

SynToolkit.name: SynToolkit 1.7
SynToolkit.notes:
## Happy Fall 🍂🪾

This release adds new Games, Audio Mixer, Tweaks, and Uninstaller tabs, a heavily reworked Power Plans tab, GPU driver downloads, and a round of UI polish and fixes.

### New

- **Audio Mixer tab**: A dedicated tab for managing your sound. Adjust the master output level, set a default level for new audio apps, and fine-tune individual app volumes while they play. Adjusted apps are remembered and restored the next time they play audio, and media sources are shown one at a time so they're easy to find.
- **Games tab**: Import the games you already own and launch them straight from SynToolkit. Discord Rich Presence has been updated to work with the new tab.
- **Tweaks tab**: See which tweaks SynergyOS applies, with toggles and extra options to adjust each one.
- **Uninstaller tab**: Uninstall apps without leaving SynToolkit.
- **Power Plans rework**: Create and modify your own power plans, and explore the settings of the preinstalled ones. You can also import a plan or switch plans from the right-click menu.
- **GPU driver downloads**: The GPU tab should now let you download drivers and optimize them from within the app.
- **Classic right-click menu**: Restore the classic Windows 10 right-click context menu on Windows 11, so you get the full menu without clicking "Show more options."
- **More tweaks**: A new SteamWebHelper toggle, MMCSS settings with a Default / Optimized / Disabled dropdown, and a new quality-of-life taskbar tweak.
- **Outdated SynergyOS install notice**: SynToolkit now tells you if you're on an old SynergyOS install, with improved detection.
- **New Home tiles**: Quick links for bug reports, the GitHub repository, and more.
- **New wallpaper**: One new fall wallpaper.

### Improved

- **Needs Attention**: The tab icon now changes when there's nothing that needs your attention. Ignore now lasts for a time you choose, and a new ignore/restore control sits in the top right.
- **Tweaks organization**: Tweaks that were scattered across the app are now grouped in one place.
- **UI polish**: A smaller sidebar and visual improvements for light mode.
- **Game cover art**: Cover art picked up during a Games scan should now be more reliable.

### Fixed

- **App installs**: Battle.net, Spotify, and Visual C++ now install correctly.
- **Games tab**: The Remove button is no longer cut off.
- **Tab crashes**: Fixed tabs crashing after the recent additions.

### Notes

- Outdated SynergyOS install detection and the cover art fix are still being tested. Please report anything unexpected through the bug report tile or the issues page.

**Download:** `SynToolkit-Setup-1.7.0.exe` through the SynergyOS Setup when prompted in Ame Wizard
